messages:
marta: Observed weirdness on the latency dashboard: p50/p95/p99 change when a request is start-routed to primary then re-routed mid-flight to shard-B. Console shows single "overall" percentile but it's unclear which route it attributes to. anyone else seen this?
devin: yes. we need a clear rule: do we attribute by initial routing decision, final execution node, or split across both? right now ingestion tags both route_initial and route_final but the UI collapses.
lee: quick data dump attached:
---
# samples (ts, route_initial, route_final, latency_ms)
2026-03-23T09:10:01Z init=primary final=primary latency_ms=95
2026-03-23T09:10:02Z init=primary final=shard-B latency_ms=340
2026-03-23T09:10:03Z init=primary final=shard-B latency_ms=310
2026-03-23T09:10:05Z init=primary final=primary latency_ms=100
---
rachel: for rollouts we often bias to initial route (caller choice) so product owners can see how their experiment does. but operator view wants final. both are valid. need UX to surface both.
infra-bot: note: telemetry pipeline currently sets "route_attribution"=final if final != initial (legacy behavior).
marta: that's the crux. legacy final attribution moves tail to shard-B and hides primary's stable p50. suggestion: console should surface three percentiles: overall (blended), by_initial, by_final. show sample_counts and a tiny toggle to pick attribution for SLOs.
devin: API change: add param `attribution_mode` to timeseries endpoints: values = ["blended","initial","final"]. default existing behavior = "final" for backwards compat. need API deprecation note.
lee: telemetry note: we'll need a lightweight rollup that indexes both keys to avoid heavy query cost. propose adding explicit aggregated keys: p50_initial, p95_initial, p99_initial, p50_final... compute at ingestion.
rachel: UX ask: in rollout charts, default to initial attribution and show a grey line for final. ops persona can flip. also add tooltip: "Why p95 jumped? 40% of tail came from final=shard-B".
marta: agree. action items: devin -> draft API spec + deprecation plan; lee -> add ingestion rollup counters and verify cost; rachel -> mockups for toggle + tooltip language; infra-bot: open ticket 81234 referencing telemetry-cost estimates.
devin: will post a short RFC tonight. also propose console adds a low-sample indicator when sample_count < 50 per attribution.
lee: I'll run a small backfill job to estimate compute delta and post numbers.
marta: thanks. if no objections I'll merge into sprint board. marking resolved for now, will follow-up in RFC. :white_check_mark:
